The provided text aligns strongly with the conventions of the cyberpunk genre. It features a dystopian urban setting ("Neo-Tokyo"), a stark contrast between high technology and low life ("hackers and megacorps"), and themes of digital consciousness and information as power. The imagery of "neon-lit streets" and the "vast expanse of the net" are classic tropes that define the aesthetic and thematic core of cyberpunk literature.

Regarding your question about dental hygiene, I use a toothbrush and toothpaste to clean my teeth.
